name: Tomás Herrera
summary: AST-02: Systolic pressure: Blood pressure outside optimal range (120/75 mmHg). Check hydration and exercise load.
guidance: Review hydration, exercise (ARED) and fluid shift toward the head. Procedure: 1. Repeat at rest after 5 min, arm at heart level. 2. Check hydration and sodium. 3. Review exercise load. 4. Repeat in 1–2 h.

name: Sofía Navarro
summary: AST-03: Heart rate: Resting HR outside usual range (59 bpm). Check hydration, rest and exercise load.
guidance: Review hydration, sleep, stress and aerobic exercise compliance. Procedure: 1. Confirm the crew member is truly at rest (5 min). 2. Check hydration and caffeine intake. 3. Cross-check with sleep hours and stress. 4. Repeat the measurement in 15 min.

name: Tomás Herrera
summary: AST-02: Body temperature: CRITICAL ALERT: Temperature 38.44 °C. Risk of heat stroke. Activate emergency protocol.
guidance: Heat / fever emergency. Procedure: 1. Active cooling (cold cloths, ventilation). 2. Hydrate if conscious. 3. Monitor consciousness, HR and BP. 4. Contact Mission Control. 5. Prepare medical emergency.

name: Tomás Herrera
summary: AST-02: Body temperature: High temperature after activity (38.53 °C). Reduce intensity and hydrate.
guidance: Reduce intensity and cool down. Procedure: 1. Lower intensity. 2. Hydrate. 3. Direct ventilation. 4. Measure again at 15 min.

name: Tomás Herrera
summary: AST-02: Systolic pressure: Blood pressure at risk (140/82 mmHg). Notify the medical team.
guidance: Alert the medical team; evaluate SANS and orthostatic intolerance. Procedure: 1. Confirm with a second measurement. 2. Ask about headache, blurred vision (SANS), dizziness on standing. 3. Measure HR, SpO₂ and temperature. 4. High: rest and avoid exertion. Low: lie down / raise legs and rehydrate. 5. Notify the physician. 6. Repeat every 15 min.

name: Tomás Herrera
summary: AST-02: Diastolic pressure: Blood pressure outside optimal range (135/80 mmHg). Check hydration and exercise load.
guidance: Review hydration, exercise (ARED) and fluid shift toward the head. Procedure: 1. Repeat at rest after 5 min, arm at heart level. 2. Check hydration and sodium. 3. Review exercise load. 4. Repeat in 1–2 h.

name: Sofía Navarro
summary: AST-03: Heart rate: Sustained resting tachycardia (113 bpm). Notify the medical officer.
guidance: Alert the medical team. Procedure: 1. Have the crew member sit/restrained at rest. 2. Take BP, temperature and SpO₂. 3. Ask about chest pain, dizziness, palpitations. 4. Rule out fever, dehydration and anxiety. 5. Notify the crew medical officer and Mission Control. 6. Repeat every 10 min.
